description: Check whether a payment deadline and acceptance condition are stated clearly.
review_hint: Look for due dates, invoice terms, and acceptance conditions.
output_question: Is the payment deadline clear and objectively defined?

description: Verify whether work product ownership transfer is clearly scoped.
review_hint: Check for assignment of deliverables vs. pre-existing tools and background IP.
output_question: Does the agreement distinguish newly created deliverables from pre-existing tools?

description: Inspect liability limits and indemnification obligations.
review_hint: Look for limitations of liability, caps linked to fees paid, and broad indemnities.
output_question: Is there a reciprocal and defined liability cap?
